source_evidence.observation: The deterministic WorkExecutionBinding preimage includes causal_id but does not include session_id, parent agent_id, task_id, turn_id, or causal generation. Its generation field is workpackage generation.
CausalIdentity explicitly distinguishes session_id + agent_id + task_id + turn_id + causal_id + generation and does not enforce repository-global uniqueness of causal_id by itself.

TelemetryWriter stores identity.generation into system_events.generation, so this column carries causal generation, not workpackage generation. The same bare field name therefore denotes two distinct generation domains across current Stage-1 sources.
The canonical reconciliation already requires preserving explicit CausalIdentity parent/child lineage and fusing it into the survivor.

hypotheses: Until the reconciled CausalIdentity tuple is fused into the canonical WP-102 binding, the current deterministic binding projection is insufficient to distinguish two admissible causal contexts that share the same causal_id and the same work-execution fields but differ in omitted session/task/turn/causal-generation identity.
Cross-component integration is vulnerable to generation-domain confusion because telemetry generation is causal generation while WorkExecutionBinding generation is workpackage generation.
counterhypotheses: A stronger upstream invariant may make causal_id globally unique across all sessions/tasks/turns and may be mechanically enforced before WP-102. If that invariant exists and is executable, causal_id-only projection could be sufficient at this boundary.

All integrations may already carry schema-qualified field meaning and never join or compare the two bare generation fields. If executable tests prove that, the naming overlap is cosmetic rather than causal.
falsification_or_fix_gate: Either prove and cite an executable upstream invariant that makes causal_id globally unique at the WP-102 admission boundary, or fuse the complete required CausalIdentity identity (or a deterministic collision-separating digest over that tuple) into the canonical WP-102 binding preimage.

Make generation domains explicit at integration boundaries (for example causal_generation versus work_generation, or typed nested identities) or prove with executable schema-qualified integration tests that the current bare names cannot be confused.

Add a regression proving two admissible contexts that differ only in session/task/turn/causal-generation cannot collapse to one work-execution binding unless a mechanically enforced global causal_id uniqueness invariant makes the case inadmissible.
next_exact_action: Canonical WP-102 owner should resolve this falsifier during the already-required survivor/duplicate fusion and Stage-1 coordination tests; do not start a competing WP-102 implementation.
